title: PrivateEvent
description:
An immutable observed fact that must never be published. Same append-only discipline as the public log, different destination: `private/events/`, which is gitignored.
These events exist because identity resolution de-pseudonymises. A record saying "sender_id X is datatracker person 105857" turns the public log's hashes into named individuals, and PROBLEM.md section 7 keeps any label attached to a named individual out of publication. Nothing derived from this log may be published except as an aggregate that names nobody.
The community-conferred seed is computed from these facts. The seed *rule* is published (docs/seed-rule.md); the seed *membership* is not, and does not have to be — anyone can recompute it from the published rule and the same public datatracker API, which is what makes it contestable.

event_id.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of {event_type, payload}. Idempotency key.

SenderResolved.description: An address seen on a list, mapped to a datatracker person — or explicitly mapped to nothing. "No datatracker record" is recorded as a fact, never as an inference about why, per PROBLEM.md section 8.

sender_id.description: The hash that appears in the public log. The join key.

address.description: Plaintext, and the reason this log is gitignored.

origin.description: The datatracker `origin` field for the address, verbatim — it states how the address entered the system, e.g. "author: draft-foo-bar". It is recorded because it is informative, and deliberately NOT used by the seed rule: an individual submission is self-conferred standing.

DatatrackerRecordFetched.description: What the datatracker said about one person at one moment. Facts only; the seed rule is applied later, as a projection, so re-deciding the rule never requires re-crawling and never rewrites history.

chair_roles.description: Current and historic chair roles, with the group's type resolved.

rfc_authorships.description: Count of documents of type rfc this person is an author of.

wg_document_authorships.description: Names of documents whose group is a working group AND whose name starts with "draft-ietf-", capped at 10. Names are kept rather than a bare count so the adopted-document test is applied to the actual name instead of trusting the group filter as a proxy for adoption.

endpoints.description: The API paths this record was assembled from, for audit.

RoleFact.description: One role, recorded as the query that found it rather than as a resolved group object. The datatracker can filter roles by group type and acronym directly, so the group's type is known by construction and no extra per-group request is made.

group_ref.description: The group or grouphistory resource URI the role points at.

group_type.description: Known from the filter that matched: "wg" for the WG-chair query, "iab_or_iesg" for the IAB/IESG query, "" when the query did not constrain the group type (the AD query).

current.description: true from the role endpoint, false from rolehistory.
